newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill comfirms Lilly buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill comfirms Lilly buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch pharmaceuticals analyst Richard Vietor said he reiterated an intermediate and long-term buy recommendation on Eli Lilly & Co, whose shares were up 2-5/8 to 94-7/8.
-- The analyst did not provide details, but confirmed market reports of the reiteration.

-- A spokeswoman for the Indianapolis-based drugmaker said it plans to present widely anticipated clinical data for its new osteoporosis drug raloxifene, trade named Evista, on Thursday in Washington, at the National Osteoporosis Foundation's annual meeting.
The spokeswoman refused to provide details of the data. She added that two analysts' meetings on the data are scheduled for Friday in Washington.
